description: Create a short-lived signing URL for an embedded recipient, to be rendered in an iframe inside your application. The envelope must be in 'in_progress' status and the link expires after 10 minutes, so create it when the signer is ready (one link per signing session). On documents with a signingOrder the link can only be created once it is the recipient's turn; the envelope.recipient.activated webhook event signals that moment. When the session ends the iframe redirects to returnUrl with event (signing_complete, voided, expired or not_found), envelopeId, documentId and recipientId appended as query parameters; existing returnUrl query parameters are preserved.

recipientId.description: The recipient ID of the embedded recipient

returnUrl.description: URL the signing session redirects to when it ends

name: create_embed_link
